messages.author: 7ed6d676c4031a0b
messages.subject: Garnett installation
parts:
I have Monocle installed in my R version 3.5.1 and I am experiencing a problem when I try to install Garnett. 

> devtools::install_github("cole-trapnell-lab/garnett")
Downloading GitHub repo cole-trapnell-lab/garnett@master
Skipping 7 packages not available: AnnotationDbi, Biobase, DelayedArray, DelayedMatrixStats, monocle, org.Hs.eg.db, org.Mm.eg.db
Installing 10 packages: DelayedArray, DelayedMatrixStats, doParallel, futile.logger, futile.options, glmnet, lambda.r, org.Hs.eg.db, org.Mm.eg.db, rly
Installing packages into ‘C:/Users/username/Documents/R/win-library/3.5’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Error: (converted from warning) packages ‘DelayedArray’, ‘DelayedMatrixStats’, ‘org.Hs.eg.db’, ‘org.Mm.eg.db’ are not available (for R version 3.5.2)
> library(garnett)
Error in library(garnett) : there is no package called ‘garnett’

I guess there is nothing to do with R version as 3.5 and later releases should be fine.

Anybody experiencing something similar to that?

Thanks in advance!!

messages.author: 085d3d5aaca33554
messages.subject: Re: Garnett installation
parts:
Hi Isaiah,

Looks like the install instructions on Monocle are a little out of date. I just updated the Garnett documentation on the website with new installation instructions here: https://cole-trapnell-lab.github.io/garnett/docs/#install-from-github

Give this a try and reply back if it doesn't fix the issue.

Best,
Hannah
